text: {"score":2,"justification":"The core billing numbers match the card, but several claims are unsupported or misattributed, and the headline contradicts the body. The code-written examples and next steps are generic and omit the strongest evidence.","problems":["Headline says 99215 share is elevated at every complexity level, but the card's 5+ stratum shows 0.25 vs 0.236 for all providers, essentially no excess. Rationale also says it is highest relative to peers among 0-3 conditions, which the headline overstates.","Rationale cites C0056698 as 'rash'; the card shows dx R21 (rash) with 0 conditions, which is fine, but C0056690 'follow-up code' (Z09) in a 74-year-old is thin support. C0056566 and C0056672 are M54.50 back pain, which is accurate.","Cloning claims ('signs of cloning', C0056542 flagged as bulk-created, paste-heavy, late, problem-list padded) have no per-claim support on the card; note-check percentages (problems 40%, late 23%, data 27%, bulk created 20%, paste heavy 17%) are not on the card and are only partly confirmed. The script could not match 23 and 27.","The comparison figure '17% for comparison providers' is a misreading: the card gives all-provider rate 0.174 for 99215 below billed, and the provider's overall below-billed is 1 of 30, which is not mentioned as a finding.","Mentions C0056597 and C0056662 as possibly cloned with no evidence; C0056597 is not a documented claim on the card.","The example claims in the fixed format cite C0056517 (a 99214 with low MDM, the only below-billed note) alongside two low-complexity 99215s, but omit the strongest supportive examples. The next steps are generic, with no request for specific documented-vs-undocumented 99215 claims or an overpayment estimate.","The statement 'the support itself is questionable' due to high MDM on simple diagnoses is speculative, since the card shows MDM high with time of 47 and 49 minutes, which supports the billed level."]}
